title: Tannery solid waste generation trend and sustainable management techniques for commercialization
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,18123-18143
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09580H, Review Article

Debanjon Sarker, Saidur Rahman Shakil, Nazmul Huda, Hridoy Roy, Manjushree Chowdhury, Md. Shahinoor Islam
This study reveals sustainable use of tannery wastes by resource recovery in circular economy perspective. It also emphasizes on policy reform, stakeholders collaboration, and future research focused on LCA and TEA in the context of multiple SDGs.
